[EN] Mission Orders

Killian's "musicians" torture hundreds of prisoners for his pleasure.

Execute Killian's {@LinkCreature:476#2001#bandmasters} and {@LinkCreature:476#2003#musicians} throughout the Labyrinth of Terror.

Report to Raneria in Habere when the mission is complete.
[ES] Mission Orders

Los "músicos" de Killian torturan a cientos de prisioneros para su placer.

Ejecuta a los {@LinkCreature:476#2001#bandmasters} y {@LinkCreature:476#2003#musicians} de Killian por todo el Labyrinth of Terror.

Reportate con Raneria en Habere cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!
